bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/userbot-report-cd7368f-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = cd7368f64f2f45e6a5359cde4d722c910a8d2845 || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p ExecStart --value | grep -q 'userbot_keepalive.py' || exit 63
test "$(git -C "$root" hash-object scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py)" = cab92099b37ba2c9de3f15007e94d651936216e5 || exit 64
test "$(git -C "$root" hash-object scripts/userbot_test_client.py)" = 08a87c2d350906204d555713dd96d54d10ce9c8f || exit 65
rollback="$HOME/.local/state/tgtumbler/bugreport-userbot-code-rollback-20261115"
mkdir -p "$rollback"
chmod 700 "$rollback"
cp -p "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$rollback/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
cp -p "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" "$rollback/userbot_test_client.py"
cp "$stage/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
cp "$stage/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
test "$(git -C "$root" hash-object scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py)" = 5ff8abf0e5cd918a12eceb52a81a04472ad218b1 || exit 66
test "$(git -C "$root" hash-object scripts/userbot_test_client.py)" = 7925aeb4a9de84a23c70768049c418d6bf29dcb4 || exit 67
python3 -m py_compile "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 68
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 69
sleep 4
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
cd "$root"
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio, pathlib, os, stat, sys
from userbot_test_client import invoke
from userbot_resident_ipc import SOCKET_PATH
from userbot_session import SESSION_BASE
assert SOCKET_PATH.is_socket() and stat.S_IMODE(SOCKET_PATH.stat().st_mode)==0o600
session=SESSION_BASE.with_suffix(".session")
assert session.is_file() and not session.is_symlink() and stat.S_IMODE(session.stat().st_mode)==0o600
status=asyncio.run(invoke("health"))
assert status.get("status")=="PASS" and status.get("authorized") is True
result=asyncio.run(invoke("report_recipient_id"))
recipient=result.get("recipient_id")
assert result.get("status")=="PASS" and type(recipient)==int and 10000<=recipient<2**53
target=pathlib.Path("deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt")
assert not target.is_symlink()
target.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
fd=os.open(target,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,"w") as f:
    f.write(str(recipient)+"\n")
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
assert stat.S_IMODE(target.stat().st_mode)==0o600
print("USERBOT_REPORT_RECIPIENT_PRIVATE_FILE=READY")
print("USERBOT_AUTHORIZED=PASS")
PY
echo USERBOT_REPORT_ACTIVATION=PASS
